placeholders.fighter: Player fighter's full name, e.g. "Sam Kincaid".
placeholders.nickname: Player's nickname without quotes (may be empty; avoid in required text).
placeholders.opponent: Opponent's full name (for signature fighters, use first + last, no nickname).
placeholders.opponentRank: Opponent rank number only, 1-10 (text adds the #). Only used in rankedOpponent offers.
placeholders.opponentDiscipline: Label from ui.json labels.disciplines, e.g. "Muay Thai".
placeholders.opponentApproach: Label from ui.json labels.approaches, e.g. "Pressure Brawler".
placeholders.champion: Current champion's full name in the player's weight class.
placeholders.rank: Player's current/new rank number only, 1-10 (text adds the #).
placeholders.eventName: Event name, e.g. "AFL 27" or "AFL Fight Night: Houston".
placeholders.weeksLabel: Pre-formatted, pluralized duration, e.g. "1 week", "6 weeks".
placeholders.stat: Label of the main stat raised, from ui.json labels.stats.
placeholders.stat2: Label of a second stat raised.
placeholders.stat2Gain: Pre-formatted gain for stat2. If there's no second stat, use a variant without {stat2} or trim the trailing clause.
placeholders.move: Name of a signature move unlocked by cross-training, from ui.json labels.moves.
placeholders.bodyPart: Lowercase body part, e.g. "shoulder", "knee", "ribs" (see ui.json labels.bodyParts).
placeholders.method: Lowercase finish method, e.g. "rear-naked choke", "knockout", "leg-kick TKO" (see ui.json labels.methodsInline).
placeholders.fights: Player's total number of pro fights.
placeholders.rankJumpLabel: Pre-formatted, pluralized possible rank jump shown on the offer card, e.g. "3 spots", "1 spot".
placeholders.planSummary: Short Auto-plan summary built from training labels, e.g. "2 weeks of wrestling, 2 of sparring, roadwork, and a rest week".
placeholders.defensesLabel: Pre-formatted, pluralized, e.g. "1 title defense", "4 title defenses".

standard.title: Fight Offer
standard.text: {promotionShort} matchmakers want you against {opponent} at {eventName}. {opponentDiscipline} base, {opponentApproach} style. Camp: {weeksLabel}.

standard.title: New Fight on the Table
standard.text: {opponent} ({opponentRecord}) has agreed to face you at {eventName}. The purse is {purse}. Your call.

standard.title: Matchup Proposed
standard.text: Your manager just hung up with the {promotionShort}: {opponent} at {eventName}, {weeksLabel} out. "Good fight, good money," he says. "Your call."

standard.title: Contract Arrived
standard.text: A bout agreement for {eventName} is sitting in your inbox. Opponent: {opponent}, a {opponentApproach}. Purse: {purse}.

standard.title: They Asked for You
standard.text: {opponent} called you out by name. The {promotionShort} is happy to book it for {eventName}. Purse: {purse}.

standard.title: Solid Test
standard.text: {opponent} brings a {opponentRecord} record and a {opponentDiscipline} base. Win this one at {eventName} and people start paying attention.

shortNotice.title: Short-Notice Call
shortNotice.text: Someone on the {eventName} card just pulled out. Can you face {opponent} in {weeksLabel}? Purse: {purse}, short-notice bonus included.

shortNotice.title: The Phone Rings
shortNotice.text: Your manager, out of breath: "{opponent} needs a dance partner at {eventName}. Only {weeksLabel} out. It's a lot of money, kid."

shortNotice.title: Fill-In Opportunity
shortNotice.text: The {promotionShort} needs a replacement against {opponent}. Half a camp, but the spotlight is real and so is the purse: {purse}.

shortNotice.title: Last-Minute Offer
shortNotice.text: A {weightClass} bout at {eventName} fell apart. Step in against {opponent} with {weeksLabel} to prepare? Fortune favors the bold. Usually.

shortNotice.title: Be a Hero
shortNotice.text: Take {opponent} on short notice and the {promotionShort} won't forget it. Lose and nobody will blame you. Much.

rankedOpponent.title: Ranked Opponent
rankedOpponent.text: #{opponentRank} {opponent} is willing to fight you at {eventName}. Beat a ranked name and you skip a few rungs on the ladder.

rankedOpponent.title: Step Up in Competition
rankedOpponent.text: The {promotionShort} offers you #{opponentRank} {opponent}. Big risk, bigger reward. Purse: {purse}.

rankedOpponent.title: Contender Bout
rankedOpponent.text: {opponent} sits at #{opponentRank} in the {weightClass} rankings and wants to stay there. Go take the spot. {eventName}, {weeksLabel} out.

rankedOpponent.title: Rankings on the Line
rankedOpponent.text: A win over #{opponentRank} {opponent} at {eventName} puts your name on the list everyone reads. A loss puts you back in line.

rankedOpponent.title: Big Jump Available
rankedOpponent.text: Beat #{opponentRank} {opponent} and you could climb {rankJumpLabel}. That's the kind of win that changes a career.

mainEvent.title: Main Event Offer
mainEvent.text: Your name on top of the poster: {fighter} vs. {opponent}, headlining {eventName}. Purse: {purse}.

mainEvent.title: Headliner
mainEvent.text: The {promotionShort} wants you closing the show at {eventName} against {opponent}. Bright lights, big check: {purse}.

mainEvent.title: Top of the Card
mainEvent.text: {eventName} needs a main event and the fans voted for you vs. {opponent}. Don't let them down.

rematch.title: Rematch Offer
rematch.text: {opponent} wants the rematch, and so do the fans. Run it back at {eventName}? Purse: {purse}.

rematch.title: Unfinished Business
rematch.text: Last time with {opponent} left questions. The {promotionShort} wants answers at {eventName}.

rematch.title: Run It Back
rematch.text: {opponent} hasn't stopped talking about your first fight. Settle it for good at {eventName}.

declined.title: Offer Declined
declined.text: You passed on {opponent}. The matchmakers will call again, but they keep score too.

declined.title: Not This Time
declined.text: You turned down {eventName}. Your manager sighs and goes back to his phone.

declined.title: Pass
declined.text: Fight declined. {opponent} is already telling reporters you ducked him.

great.title: Camp Report: Excellent
great.text: Best camp of your career. Your coaches have nothing left to fix. {stat} {statGain}, {stat2} {stat2Gain}.

great.title: Camp Report: Peak Form
great.text: You're sharp, fast, and dangerous. Sparring partners started calling in sick. {stat} {statGain}.

great.title: Camp Report: Locked In
great.text: Every drill clicked. You walk into fight week in the best shape of your life. {stat} {statGain}, {stat2} {stat2Gain}.

great.title: Camp Report: On Fire
great.text: Your coach used the word "scary" twice this week, and he never says anything nice. {stat} {statGain}.

good.title: Camp Report: Solid
good.text: A good, honest camp. No surprises, steady gains. {stat} {statGain}.

good.title: Camp Report: On Track
good.text: You hit your targets and made weight easy. {stat} {statGain}, {stat2} {stat2Gain}.

good.title: Camp Report: Ready
good.text: Not your flashiest camp, but you did the work. You're ready for {opponent}. {stat} {statGain}.

good.title: Camp Report: Building
good.text: Small improvements everywhere. Your coach nods, which counts as a compliment. {stat} {statGain}.

bad.title: Camp Report: Rough
bad.text: Nothing clicked. You're heavy-legged and a step slow. Fatigue is high going into fight week.

bad.title: Camp Report: Overtrained
bad.text: You pushed too hard and your body pushed back. You'll walk out tired. Consider more rest weeks next camp.

bad.title: Camp Report: Distracted
bad.text: Bad sleep, bad sparring, bad vibes. {stat} barely moved. Time to fight through it.

bad.title: Camp Report: Flat
bad.text: Your coach watched you hit pads and said nothing. That's worse than yelling.

injury.title: Camp Setback
injury.text: You tweaked your {bodyPart} in sparring. Training slows down this week.

injury.title: Injury Scare
injury.text: A bad scramble left your {bodyPart} sore. The doctor says rest; your coach says ice. You lose a week of training.

injury.title: Banged Up
injury.text: You'll fight, but your {bodyPart} isn't 100%. Expect it to slow you down on fight night.

injury.title: Pulled From Camp Work
injury.text: Your {bodyPart} needs time. Do you want to keep the fight or ask for a new date?

sparring.title: Sparring Week
sparring.text: Hard rounds with the team. You traded, learned, and only got embarrassed a little. {stat} {statGain}.

sparring.title: Sparring Week
sparring.text: You spent the week getting punched by people who are good at punching. It helped. {stat} {statGain}.

sparring.title: Sparring Week
sparring.text: Your timing is sharper and your nose is slightly crooked-er. {stat} {statGain}.

wrestling.title: Wrestling Week
wrestling.text: Shots, sprawls, and a lot of mat burn. {stat} {statGain}.

wrestling.title: Wrestling Week
wrestling.text: The wrestling coach made you drill chain shots until you dreamed about them. {stat} {statGain}.

wrestling.title: Wrestling Week
wrestling.text: You finished every practice face-down on the mat. That's how you know it worked. {stat} {statGain}.

bjj.title: BJJ Week
bjj.text: Rolling every day. You got tapped a lot and learned twice as much. {stat} {statGain}.

bjj.title: BJJ Week
bjj.text: Sweeps, back takes, and choke defense. Your grappling feels slicker. {stat} {statGain}.

bjj.title: BJJ Week
bjj.text: A blue belt half your size tied you in a knot. Humbling. Useful. {stat} {statGain}.

muayThaiPads.title: Muay Thai Pads
muayThaiPads.text: Your pad holder's arms are shaking. Kicks, knees, elbows, repeat. {stat} {statGain}.

muayThaiPads.title: Muay Thai Pads
muayThaiPads.text: Teeps, leg kicks, and a hundred elbows a round. {stat} {statGain}.

muayThaiPads.title: Muay Thai Pads
muayThaiPads.text: Your shins are bruised and your kicks are louder. {stat} {statGain}.

roadwork.title: Roadwork Week
roadwork.text: Early miles, hill sprints, and zero excuses. {stat} {statGain}.

roadwork.title: Roadwork Week
roadwork.text: You ran until your lungs filed a complaint. {stat} {statGain}.

roadwork.title: Roadwork Week
roadwork.text: Sunrise runs every morning. Your gas tank just got bigger. {stat} {statGain}.

rest.title: Rest Week
rest.text: Sleep, food, stretching. Your body says thank you. Fatigue down.

rest.title: Rest Week
rest.text: You took the week easy. Your coach pretended not to be annoyed. Fatigue down.

rest.title: Rest Week
rest.text: Recovery is training too. You feel fresh again. Fatigue down.

autoPlan.title: Auto-Plan Set
autoPlan.text: Your coach built this camp around {opponent}: {planSummary}. You just show up and work.

autoPlan.title: Coach's Plan
autoPlan.text: Camp is on autopilot. Your coach picked {planSummary} for the next {weeksLabel}.

autoPlan.title: Plan Locked In
autoPlan.text: Auto-plan ready: {planSummary}. Change any week if you disagree.

crossTrainUnlock.title: New Move Unlocked
crossTrainUnlock.text: Cross-training paid off: you've added the {move} from {discipline} to your game.

crossTrainUnlock.title: New Weapon
crossTrainUnlock.text: All those {discipline} sessions finally clicked. {move} unlocked.

crossTrainUnlock.title: Skill Learned
crossTrainUnlock.text: Your coach finally signed off on the {move}. Time to use it on fight night.

up.title: Rankings Update
up.text: You climb to #{rank} in the {weightClass} rankings.

up.title: Moving Up
up.text: Up from #{oldRank} to #{rank}. The contenders above you just got a little nervous.

up.title: Climbing
up.text: The {promotionShort} rankings panel moves you to #{rank}. Keep winning and they'll have to keep moving you.

up.title: New Rank: #{rank}
up.text: That win got noticed. You're now the #{rank} {weightClass} in the {promotionShort}.

down.title: Rankings Update
down.text: You slip to #{rank} in the {weightClass} rankings.

down.title: Moving Down
down.text: Down from #{oldRank} to #{rank}. Time to get back to work.

down.title: Setback
down.text: The loss costs you: you're now #{rank}. The ladder is still there. Climb it again.

down.title: New Rank: #{rank}
down.text: A tough result drops you to #{rank}. Nobody remembers the fall if you come back.

entered.title: You're Ranked!
entered.text: Your name is officially on the list: #{rank} in the {promotionShort} {weightClass} division.

entered.title: Top 10
entered.text: The panel can't ignore you anymore. Welcome to the rankings at #{rank}.

entered.title: Somebody Now
entered.text: Unranked to #{rank}. Your phone won't stop buzzing.

entered.title: On the Board
entered.text: You've cracked the {weightClass} top 10 at #{rank}. The real fights start now.

droppedOut.title: Out of the Rankings
droppedOut.text: You've fallen out of the {weightClass} top 10. Win your way back in.

droppedOut.title: Unranked
droppedOut.text: Your name is off the list. Plenty of champions have been here before.

droppedOut.title: Back to the Grind
droppedOut.text: The rankings moved on without you. Time to make them notice again.

numberOne.title: #1 Contender
numberOne.text: You're the #1 {weightClass} contender. Only {champion} stands above you.

numberOne.title: Top of the Ladder
numberOne.text: Number one. Every road in the {weightClass} division now leads to {champion}.

numberOne.title: Next in Line
numberOne.text: You're #1. The {promotionShort} can't keep the title from you much longer.

offered.title: Title Shot!
offered.text: It's official: you will challenge {champion} for the {promotionShort} {weightClass} championship at {eventName}. Five rounds.

offered.title: The Call
offered.text: The {promotionShort} president himself called: "You earned it. {champion}. {eventName}. Five rounds for the belt."

offered.title: Championship Bout
offered.text: {fighter} vs. {champion} for the {weightClass} title. {weeksLabel} to prepare. Purse: {purse}.

offered.title: Everything You Worked For
offered.text: From an unknown with a gym bag to the main event: you're fighting {champion} for the belt at {eventName}.

finishStreak.title: Earned the Hard Way
finishStreak.text: Finish after finish, and the fans are chanting your name. The {promotionShort} is jumping you to a title shot against {champion}.

finishStreak.title: Too Dangerous to Wait
finishStreak.text: You're only #{rank}, but nobody wants to fight you anymore. {champion} has to. Title fight at {eventName}.

finishStreak.title: Fast Track
finishStreak.text: Your finishing streak forced their hand: you get {champion} for the belt at {eventName}.

win.title: NEW CHAMPION!
win.text: You beat {champion} by {method} to become the {promotionShort} {weightClass} champion!

win.title: And NEW!
win.text: The belt is yours. {fighter} is the {weightClass} champion of the {promotionShort}.

win.title: King of the Cage
win.text: You came in a challenger and leave with gold. {method} in round {round}. Nobody can take this night away.

win.title: Champion
win.text: From the bottom of the ladder to the top of the division. Enjoy it. Everyone's coming for you now.

defense.title: Title Retained
defense.text: You defend the {weightClass} belt against {opponent} by {method}. {defensesLabel} and counting.

defense.title: Still Champion
defense.text: {opponent} came for the crown and left without it. {defensesLabel}.

defense.title: Defense Complete
defense.text: Another challenger, another answer: {method} in round {round}. The belt stays home.

defense.title: Untouchable
defense.text: {defensesLabel}. People are starting to call this an era.

loss.title: Title Lost
loss.text: {opponent} takes your {weightClass} belt by {method}. The reign is over. For now.

loss.title: Dethroned
loss.text: You gave everything, but tonight belonged to {opponent}. You'll want that rematch.

loss.title: End of the Reign
loss.text: {defensesLabel} as champion. Tonight, {opponent} wrote a new chapter.

loss.title: The Belt Changes Hands
loss.text: It hurts. It's supposed to. Get back up and climb again.

challengerLoss.title: So Close
challengerLoss.text: {champion} retains by {method}. You were five rounds from history. Next time.

challengerLoss.title: Not Tonight
challengerLoss.text: The champ was better tonight. You'll learn from this, and you'll be back.

challengerLoss.title: Fell Short
challengerLoss.text: Your first title shot ends in a loss to {champion}. Plenty of champions lost their first one too.

winKo.title: Knockout Win!
winKo.text: You stopped {opponent} cold in round {round}. That one will be on highlight reels for a while.

winKo.title: Lights Out
winKo.text: One clean shot at {time} of round {round}, and {opponent} was done. Clean KO.

winKo.title: Flatlined
winKo.text: Knockout! The crowd is still on its feet.

winKo.title: Statement Win
winKo.text: You walked through {opponent} and knocked him out. Message sent to the division.

winTko.title: TKO Win!
winTko.text: The referee saved {opponent} at {time} of round {round}. Your win by {method}.

winTko.title: Stoppage
winTko.text: You broke {opponent} down until the ref had seen enough. TKO in round {round}.

winTko.title: Ref Waves It Off
winTko.text: Too much, too fast. {opponent} couldn't keep up, and the ref stepped in.

winSubmission.title: Submission Win!
winSubmission.text: {opponent} taps to a {method} in round {round}. Beautiful work on the mat.

winSubmission.title: Tap, Tap, Tap
winSubmission.text: You locked in the {method} and {opponent} had no choice. Submission win.

winSubmission.title: Mat Magic
winSubmission.text: Submission at {time} of round {round}. Your grappling coach is very smug right now.

winDecision.title: Decision Win
winDecision.text: You go the distance and take a unanimous decision over {opponent}.

winDecision.title: Clear on the Cards
winDecision.text: All three judges saw it your way. A smart, disciplined win.

winDecision.title: Went the Distance
winDecision.text: No finish, but no doubt either. You outworked {opponent} for the win.

winSplitDecision.title: Split Decision Win
winSplitDecision.text: Two judges had it for you, one didn't. A win is a win.

winSplitDecision.title: Squeaked By
winSplitDecision.text: A razor-close fight, and you get the nod by split decision. Exhale.

winSplitDecision.title: Close Call
winSplitDecision.text: {opponent} might argue it, but the scorecards say you won.

lossKo.title: Knockout Loss
lossKo.text: {opponent} caught you in round {round}. You'll watch the replay once, then never again.

lossKo.title: Lights Out
lossKo.text: You woke up to the ref and the doctor. Tough night. Rest up.

lossKo.title: Caught Clean
lossKo.text: One shot changed everything. It happens to the best. Get back to the gym.

lossTko.title: TKO Loss
lossTko.text: The referee stepped in at {time} of round {round}. You wanted to keep going. He didn't let you.

lossTko.title: Stopped
lossTko.text: {opponent} broke you down by {method}. Regroup and come back smarter.

lossTko.title: Waved Off
lossTko.text: The ref saw enough. You'll be back, and you'll be better.

lossSubmission.title: Submission Loss
lossSubmission.text: {opponent} caught you in a {method} in round {round}. Tapping is smart. Now go drill defense.

lossSubmission.title: Caught
lossSubmission.text: You tapped to a {method}. Your grappling coach has a few notes. A lot of notes.

lossSubmission.title: Tapped Out
lossSubmission.text: The {method} was tight and you had nowhere to go. Learn it. Fix it.

lossDecision.title: Decision Loss
lossDecision.text: You lose a unanimous decision to {opponent}. Learn from the tape.

lossDecision.title: Outpointed
lossDecision.text: {opponent} did more on the cards tonight. Time to get back in the lab.

lossDecision.title: Went the Distance
lossDecision.text: You lasted every round, but the judges went the other way.

lossSplitDecision.title: Split Decision Loss
lossSplitDecision.text: One judge had it for you. Two didn't. That one's going to sting.

lossSplitDecision.title: Robbed?
lossSplitDecision.text: The crowd booed the decision. Doesn't change the record, but people saw it.

lossSplitDecision.title: So Close
lossSplitDecision.text: Split decision for {opponent}. One more good round and it was yours.

draw.title: Draw
draw.text: The judges couldn't split you. Nobody wins, nobody loses, everybody wants a rematch.

draw.title: Dead Even
draw.text: A draw against {opponent}. You'll both be thinking about this one.

draw.title: No Winner Tonight
draw.text: Even on the cards. The fans got their money's worth, anyway.

legend.title: A Legend Retires
legend.text: {fighter} retires as one of the greatest {weightClass}s the {promotionShort} has ever seen: {record}, {defensesLabel}. They'll be talking about you for years.

legend.title: The King Steps Down
legend.text: You hang up the gloves on top. {record}. {defensesLabel}. No one will forget this reign.

legend.title: Hall of Fame Career
legend.text: Champion. Icon. Legend. {fighter} walks away with the respect of everyone who ever stepped in the cage.

champion.title: Former Champion Retires
champion.text: {fighter} retires with a {record} record and a championship to show for it. Not many can say that.

champion.title: Walking Away a Champion
champion.text: You reached the top of the {weightClass} division. Whatever happens next, that belt is forever.

champion.title: Gold Forever
champion.text: Retirement after a career that included {promotionShort} gold. Your old gym already hung your poster on the wall.

contender.title: A Contender Retires
contender.text: {fighter} walks away at {record}. You fought the best and made them work for every round.

contender.title: So Close to Gold
contender.text: You never got the belt, but you made the division better. That counts.

contender.title: Respected
contender.text: Top contender, tough out, fan favorite. {fighter} retires with nothing left to prove.

journeyman.title: The Workhorse Retires
journeyman.text: {fighter} retires at {record}. You took the fights others wouldn't, and the {promotionShort} never forgot it.

journeyman.title: Ironclad
journeyman.text: Short notice, bad matchups, long trips: you said yes to all of it. Tonight the gym says thank you.

journeyman.title: Blue-Collar Career
journeyman.text: No belt, no regrets. {fights} fights, every one of them honest work.

shortCareer.title: Calling It Early
shortCareer.text: {fighter} hangs up the gloves at {record}. Some fighters know when it's time.

shortCareer.title: New Chapter
shortCareer.text: Not every story ends with a belt. You fought in the {promotionShort}, and most people never get that far.

shortCareer.title: Done
shortCareer.text: The fight game is hard. You gave it a real shot. Time for whatever comes next.
